telnet_unavailable.title: {model} does not accept a control connection
telnet_unavailable.description:
The {model} answers on the network, but has not accepted a telnet connection on port 23 for several minutes. Until it does, the media players work over the web interface only: power, volume, mute and source, with up to 10 seconds delay. All other settings are unavailable.

The receiver allows only one telnet connection at a time. Common causes:

- Another integration or program holds that connection, for example the official Denon AVR integration or another home automation system. Remove or disable it for this receiver.
- A firewall or VLAN rule blocks port 23 between Home Assistant and the receiver, while the web ports are open.

The message disappears by itself as soon as the connection works again.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw telnet command to the receiver, for settings without an entity. Asked for a response, returns the receiver's replies.

command.name: Command
command.description: As in the protocol documents, for example PSDYNEQ ON or MV?. Printable ASCII, at most {max_length} characters.
